error_sample.message: Rate limit reached for model openai/gpt-oss-120b ... TPM Limit 8000 ... Please try again in ~2–8s

interpretation: Continuous live-suite execution on the free/on_demand Groq tier is rate-limited. These are infrastructure throttles, not product assertion failures. After cooldown, the same scenario ids passed 3/3. Do not treat continuous live PASS as a CI gate.
mitigations: Rerun only failed ids after cooldown
Keep deterministic suite as the CI gate
